title: tally stores the ledger as one text file: a header line, then one entry per line as key=value fields joined by |, the note always last
text: Format decision for the ledger file. Entries are one per line, fields are key=value joined by |, and the note is the last field and may be empty. A note may not contain | or a line break, and tally add refuses both. The parser and the writer live together in src/parse.cjs.

title: Amounts are integer cents everywhere in tally; money.parse turns user input into cents and refuses more than two decimals
text: Amounts are integer cents in memory, in the file and in JSON output. Strings appear only at the edges, through src/money.cjs. money.parse('12.5') is 1250 and money.parse('1.234') is null. Code that needs a decimal string calls money.format.

title: bin/tally.cjs maps command names to modules in src/cmd-*.cjs; each exports run(argv, { file }) and returns an exit status
text: The dispatcher keeps a COMMANDS table of name to module path and loads a module only when its name matches. A new command is one new src/cmd-<name>.cjs file plus one line in that table. The ledger path is passed in as { file }.

title: Command flags are parsed by src/args.cjs with a spec of bool or value flags; an unknown flag is a usage error, never ignored
text: src/args.cjs parse(argv, spec) returns { positional, opts }. A flag missing from the spec stops the command with a usage error naming it. A command that wants a new flag adds it to its spec, so the check stays in one place.

title: The ledger path comes from TALLY_FILE, else tally.dat in the working directory; tests build temp ledgers with test/helpers.cjs
text: Commands never take the file as an argument. test/helpers.cjs gives tmpFile(content) for a fresh ledger and tally(args, file) to run the CLI against it with TALLY_FILE set. Tests that read the shipped sample use test/fixtures/sample.tally.

title: store.add gives each entry the largest id plus one, so ids are never reused within a file
text: Ids are assigned by store.add when an entry is appended. Nothing deletes entries today, so ids only grow. The report counts entries by array length, not by id.

title: report is built by cmd-report.cjs summarise(); period bounds come from dates.dayStart so they follow the ledger's zone
text: summarise returns the period, the per-category totals, the entry count and the grand total. The period is the first and last entry day passed through dates.dayStart and dates.toIso. Text and JSON output are two renderings of that one object.

title: tally add refuses notes containing | or a line break, because the file format cannot hold them
text: A | would split the note into a bogus field and a line break would split the entry. The check is in src/cmd-add.cjs and exits with a usage error before the ledger is touched.

title: src/dates.cjs reads process.env.TZ once at load; date tests pass only under TZ=UTC, which test/run.cjs sets for the test process, so run tests with npm test
text: Running node --test directly makes the dates tests fail, because an unset TZ means a legacy US Eastern offset on purpose: ledger files from tally 0.3 and earlier assume it. Setting process.env.TZ inside a test file is too late, since dates.cjs has already loaded. The failing dates tests are not a bug to fix by making dates.cjs always use UTC.

title: Usage errors must go through src/usage.cjs fail(): it prints 'tally: <message>' on stderr and exits 2; a bare process.exit(2) breaks the contract test
text: test/contract.test.cjs scans src/ and bin/ and fails on any process.exit(2) outside src/usage.cjs. The integration tests also match the stderr prefix 'tally:'. fail() writes synchronously so the message survives the exit.

title: JSON output must use src/emit.cjs stable(): keys sorted at every depth; test/golden/*.json are compared byte for byte and the contract test checks key order
text: JSON.stringify keeps insertion order, which for an entry is id, date, category, amount, note, and that order is not the contract. stable() sorts keys at every depth and ends with one newline. Golden files in test/golden are compared with Buffer.compare.

title: src/store.cjs edits entries in place after load(), so a cache keyed by array or entry identity goes stale; key totals by content instead
text: store.edit does Object.assign on the shared entry object and add pushes onto the shared array, and callers may assign fields directly. The array keeps its identity through all of it. The in-place edit test in test/store.test.cjs checks that a total follows an edit.

title: test/fixtures/v1/crlf.tally has CRLF line endings and src/parse.cjs splits on LF only, so the last field (the note) keeps a trailing carriage return
text: The v1 exports from Windows use CRLF. parseFile splits text on a bare newline, so the carriage return stays on the end of each line, and the note is the last field. test/store.test.cjs skips crlf.tally for that reason. Any change to the file format has to load that file too.

title: Format amounts only with src/money.cjs format(); (cents / 100).toFixed(2) is wrong for large amounts, for example 9007199254740990 cents
text: Amounts are integer cents up to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER. Dividing by 100 in floating point rounds the last digit for values near 2^53, so the printed total is off by a cent. money.format does integer arithmetic only and handles negative amounts.
